description: This file defines the LoginService class within the OrangeHRM authentication module. It provides methods for handling user login logging, including adding login entries for standard and OpenID Connect (OIDC) logins, using data access objects and user credential information.

classes.name: LoginService
classes.description: Service class for managing user login logs, including adding login records for standard credentials and OIDC logins.

methods.name: getLoginLogDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the LoginLogDao instance used for persisting login logs.

methods.name: addLogin
methods.description: Creates a login log entry for a user based on provided user credentials.

methods.name: addOIDCLogin
methods.description: Creates a login log entry for a user authenticated via OIDC.
